name: elagoht/uploads
description: A collage plugin that receives file uploads, validates them by their content, stores them under random keys, and serves them back safely.

config.description: A collage plugin that receives file uploads, validates them by their content, stores them under random keys, and serves them back safely.

cacheControl.description: CacheControl is the Cache-Control header Handler sends with every file; default "private, max-age=0": a browser may keep the file but must revalidate it, and a shared cache must not keep it at all.

dir.description: Dir is the directory of the disk store, used when Store is nil; default "var/uploads". A section that sets "dir" to "" explicitly is a startup error.
